content.text: {"findings":[],"floor_verdicts":[],"watching":[],"held_back":[{"thing":"Exa MCP server (exa-mcp-server)","date":"06 Oct 2026","reason":"The search job already runs through four pluggable providers behind a common interface, and an MCP server adds a tool-calling layer this fixed search-then-answer flow doesn't use; the code has no sign it would give better results.","source":"https://www.npmjs.com/package/exa-mcp-server"},{"thing":"@perplexity-ai/mcp-server","date":"25 Sep 2026","reason":"Perplexity's API is a competing answer engine for this Perplexity clone, so it is never a fit.","source":"https://www.npmjs.com/package/@perplexity-ai/mcp-server"},{"thing":"@mastra/tavily","date":"21 Oct 2026","reason":"Tavily is already integrated in tavily.py, and this package is a JavaScript wrapper for another agent framework, while the search code is Python.","source":"https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mastra/tavily"},{"thing":"firecrawl-cli","date":"27 Oct 2026","reason":"It is a command-line tool for terminals, not a search provider for the Python backend, and nothing in the code shows a gap it would fill.","source":"https://www.npmjs.com/package/firecrawl-cli"}]}
